subsection.title: PoC Demo Flow
subsection.description: - Describe the shortest connected demonstration that covers every approved core ideal use case. - Keep the same Primary Persona and explicitly preserve each use case intent. - Compose the demo from the persona's sequential actions and observable completion results.

subsection.title: Validation Checklist
subsection.description: - Map each core ideal use case intent to an observable PoC result. - Map each success criterion and Feature completion checkpoint to an observable PoC result. - State what counts as pass, fail, or not yet testable.
subsection.example: | Validation item | Related use case, Feature, or criterion | Evidence | Success judgment | |-----------------|-----------------------------------------|----------|------------------| | Product manager completes the ideal journey | Shape a rough product idea; F1, F2 | Completion result is visible | Pass when no facilitator intervention is required |

subsection.title: User Feedback Questions
subsection.description: List the few questions that test comprehension, usefulness, trust, and the most important unresolved product assumption.
